decisions: Failure mining is deterministic, sentence-level and stdlib-only; it extracts explicit failure cues, preserves document provenance and deduplicates repeated statements.
FailureCase.failure_mode captures condition, handling target or explicit failure-mode text when available; no mode is invented for unstructured failures.
Resolved language such as prevents, tolerates or handles failures is excluded to avoid promoting mitigated failure cases.
remaining_risks: Rule-based English cue coverage is limited; nuanced negation and domain-specific failure terminology are outside this task.
The repository environment has no importable ruff module; pytest, mypy, compileall and diff checks were run successfully.
limitations: No network, external dependencies, database writes or production artifacts were used.
